title: core-unit-bioinformatics/workflow-nxf-somatic-variantcomp pipeline parameters
description: Compare somatic variant calls of the same tumor/normal pairs across sequencing technologies (WGS, WES, panel)

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to the comma-separated samplesheet with one row per sample and technology.
input.help_text: Columns: sample, technology, library_type, tumor_id, normal_id, caller, vcf, tumor_bam, normal_bam, target_bed. Empty or 'n/a' marks an empty optional field. Relative paths are resolved against the samplesheet's directory. Index files are taken from next to the data files. See docs/usage.md.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

reference_options.title: Reference options
reference_options.description: Reference genome. All inputs are checked against it.

fasta.description: Reference FASTA (plain or bgzipped) that all VCFs, BEDs and BAMs were created with.

fasta_fai.description: Index of the reference FASTA. Created if not given (always for bgzipped FASTA).

max_ref_mismatch.description: Maximum fraction of VCF REF alleles that may differ from the reference before the input is rejected as being on a different build.

check_vcf_contigs.description: Check contig names and lengths and the sample columns of every VCF at the start. If false, problems are only reported as warnings (at your own risk); contig renaming still happens.

check_ref_alleles.description: Compare the REF allele of every VCF record with the reference FASTA at the start (rejects VCFs above --max_ref_mismatch). If false, this check is skipped; mismatching records are still removed by bcftools norm.

check_bam_contigs.description: Check contig names and lengths of every alignment header at the start. If false, problems are only reported as warnings.

check_bed_contigs.description: Check format, contig names and interval ends of every BED (targets, regions, exclude, genes, stratifications, known-list regions) at the start. If false, problems are only reported as warnings.

check_known_variants.description: Check contigs, positions and REF alleles of the known-variant lists at the start. If false, problems are only reported as warnings and the affected variants are dropped.

keep_mito.description: Compare variants on the mitochondrial contig (chrM/MT). By default it is dropped from every input and reported, and its length is not checked.

region_options.title: Region options
region_options.description: The comparison is restricted to the intersection of all target BEDs; these options restrict it further.

regions_bed.description: Optional BED: restrict the comparison to these regions (e.g. high-confidence regions of a truth set).

exclude_bed.description: Optional BED: remove these regions from the comparison (e.g. a blacklist).

min_region_bp.description: Minimum size (bp) of the comparison region: the common region of all target BEDs, and with alignments the callable region of every sample. A smaller region stops the run (too small for a valid benchmark).

coverage_options.title: Coverage options
coverage_options.description: If alignments are given for every technology of a sample, the comparison is restricted to the bases callable in all of them.

callable_regions.description: Restrict the comparison of each sample to the bases callable in all its alignments (mosdepth). Needs a tumor_bam for every samplesheet row (and a normal_bam for paired rows with --require_normal_coverage); the run stops at the start if one is missing. If false, alignments are not used for coverage.

min_coverage_tumor.description: Minimum depth of a tumor alignment for a base (or region) to be callable; also the threshold of the discordance class low_coverage.

min_coverage_normal.description: Minimum depth of a normal alignment for a base (or region) to be callable (with --require_normal_coverage).

callable_mode.description: 'base': per-base depth >= min_coverage_tumor / min_coverage_normal (mosdepth --quantize). 'region': mean depth of a common-region interval >= the threshold.

require_normal_coverage.description: With --callable_regions: the normal alignments must be callable, too, so every paired row (normal_id given) needs a normal_bam; the run stops at the start otherwise. If false, only the tumor alignments define the callable region.

amplicon_keep_duplicates.description: For library_type 'amplicon', keep duplicate-flagged reads for coverage and read evidence (amplicon reads share start positions, so duplicate marking removes real reads).

filter_options.title: Filter options
filter_options.description: Uniform filters applied identically to the calls of every technology before the comparison. Values come from the harmonized INFO tags (VC_T_VAF, VC_T_DP, VC_T_ALT), computed from FORMAT/AD for every caller.

filter_pass_only.description: Compare only records with FILTER PASS (or '.'). The split is the first step after the sample selection; the other records are normalized the same way and reported by the discordance step as 'filtered_non_pass' (with their FILTER value) if the other technology misses them.

vaf_source.description: Source of the VAF of every record: 'auto' = FORMAT/AF if present, else AD[1]/sum(AD); 'af' = FORMAT/AF only; 'ad' = allelic depths only. Depth is FORMAT/DP (else sum(AD)), alt reads AD[1] (else round(AF*DP)). See docs/usage.md.

max_missing_vaf.description: If more than this fraction of the tumor records of a VCF have no VAF, a warning is printed and the VAF-based results of that VCF (VAF strata, detection power) are NA.

min_vaf.description: Minimum tumor VAF of a call (0 = off).

min_depth.description: Minimum tumor depth at a call (0 = off).

min_alt_reads.description: Minimum number of tumor reads supporting the alt allele (0 = off).

comparison_options.title: Comparison options
comparison_options.description: Define the ground truth and which comparisons are made.

truth_technology.description: Technology (samplesheet column 'technology') used as ground truth for all samples.

comparison_mode.description: 'truth': compare every technology with the truth technology. 'all_pairs': additionally compare all technologies pairwise.

vaf_bins.description: Comma-separated VAF bin edges for the VAF-stratified recall (truth VAF) and precision (query VAF).

discordance_options.title: Discordance options
discordance_options.description: Classification and annotation of variants that differ between technologies.

read_evidence.description: Count the reads of every alignment at the positions of all compared variants (bcftools mpileup) to explain missed and extra calls (germline_in_normal, low_coverage, subthreshold_evidence, no_evidence) and to compute the detection power. Needs a tumor_bam for every samplesheet row. If false, no alignment is read and the evidence columns are left out.

evidence_min_mapq.description: Read evidence: minimum mapping quality of a read (bcftools mpileup --min-MQ).

evidence_min_baseq.description: Read evidence: minimum base quality (bcftools mpileup --min-BQ).

evidence_max_depth.description: Read evidence: maximum depth per position (bcftools mpileup --max-depth); high for deep panels.

gene_bed.description: Optional BED4 with gene names in the 4th column (e.g. from GENCODE).

stratification.description: Optional comma-separated sheet (columns name, bed) of stratification BEDs, e.g. GIAB homopolymers, tandem repeats, segmental duplications. Each becomes a yes/no column of the variant table.

germline_vaf.description: Normal VAF from which a discordant variant is classified as germline_in_normal.

evidence_min_alt_reads.description: Alt reads in a normal needed for germline_in_normal.

power_min_alt_reads.description: Alt reads a caller needs to call a variant (power model of the power-adjusted recall).

detection_power.description: Detection power from which a truth variant counts as detectable by the query technology.

low_vaf.description: VAF threshold of the 'low VAF' feature in the enrichment tests (truth VAF for FN/TP, query VAF for FP).

enrichment_fdr.description: Benjamini-Hochberg q-value below which an enrichment test of the report is significant (highlighted in plots and logs).

known_variant_options.title: Known variant options
known_variant_options.description: Lists of known variants: clinically required variants that every technology must find, or external truth sets.

known_variants.description: Comma-separated sheet with columns name, sample (or 'all'), mode ('required' or 'benchmark'), variants (comma-separated VCF/TSV files) and regions (BED or 'n/a').

fail_on_missing_required.description: Stop the pipeline with an error if a required variant is not found in every technology (it is always reported).

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base path or URL of the test-data repository (workflow-nxf-somatic-variantcomp-testdata). Defaults to a checkout next to the workflow repo for test profiles.

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
